entities.summary: Jacques de Castelnau-Bochetel (1620-1658), Marquis de Castelnau, was a 17th-century French aristocrat and soldier. He distinguished himself during the Thirty Years' War as lieutenant general of the King's Armies in Flanders and was elevated to the dignity of Marshal of France 3 weeks before his death.
